summary: Eton Pharmaceuticals filed a routine Form 8-K on September 28, 2026, announcing the U.S. commercial launch of IMPAVIDO (miltefosine) capsules and noting it now holds exclusive U.S. commercialization rights. The company integrated Eton Cares patient support, including $0 co-pay for eligible commercially insured patients and expanded assistance programs, with centralized distribution through Anovo Specialty Pharmacy. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisors, or regulatory clock are stated. This is an ordinary product-launch current report, not a special situation; watch commercial uptake and payer coverage rather than deal terms.
